May 30, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
National Mutual Insurance Federation Of Agricultural Cooperatives decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 5.57% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. National Mutual Insurance Federation Of Agricultural Cooperatives sold 2,900 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 49,200 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.26 million, down from 52,100 at the end of the previous reported quarter. National Mutual Insurance Federation Of Agricultural Cooperatives who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $923.56B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.36% or $0.68 during the last trading session, reaching $187.9. About 19.51M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
